  "https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases/io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/maven-metadata.xml" \
  "https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases/" ; do
